Karnataka Aims for 50% of India's Space Market

Karnataka aims to capture 50% of India's space market, with the Global Innovation Alliance (GIA) set to drive the state's global technology partnerships. Minister Priyank Kharge stated the state's ambition to secure half of the national space sector.
